Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting institutions of higher education that do not use archives and records management services from payment for those services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting institutions of higher education thatdo not use archives and records management services from payment forthose services; and amending RCW 40.14.025.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 40.14.025 and 2003 c 163 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The secretary of state and the director of financial managementshall jointly establish a procedure and formula for allocating thecosts of services provided by the division of archives and recordsmanagement to state agencies. The total amount allotted for servicesto state agencies shall not exceed the appropriation to the archivesand records management account during any allotment period. (2) There is created the archives and records management account inthe state treasury which shall consist of all fees and chargescollected under this section. The account shall be appropriatedexclusively for the payment of costs and expenses incurred in theoperation of the division of archives and records management asspecified by law. p. 1 SB 6034 (3) Institutions of higher education, as defined in RCW 28B.10.016,that do not use the services of the division of archives and recordsmanagement are not subject to its cost allocation procedure or formulaand are not required to pay the fees or charges in this section.
